newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 616 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 616 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 616 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 15 wheat, 253 corn, 328 soybean, 15 soymeal and 5 soyoil plus 5 corn call, 10 corn put and 20 soybean call options.
The overnight trend for corn was mixed at 1/2 cent per bushel lower to 1/2 higher, soybeans were 1/4 to 1-1/2 cents lower, soyoil was up 0.02 cent per lb and soymeal and wheat were unchanged.
